mesajlar.mesaj:
Dear citizens,

As per their usual cowardly ways, our neighbours over the borders are attacking our markets again by stripping all food (common and stat food), as well as important resources (wood, wheat, flour etc.).

All citizens are therefore asked not to post these items in the market and rather resort to private trades with potential buyers. As far as food items are concerned, the town has reserved enough resources to keep the tavern stocked for the foreseeable future and until the threat is removed. Furthermore, stat food will be made available by other taverns in town. I am asking tavern owners to assist in keeping the cost of food at low cost, so as to assist all citizens in these times of need.

I will be in your service, as always, and available to render assistance and advice or further details to every citizen that needs such.

Sincerely yours,

Evan T Campbell
